near_duplicate_suspect_statistics.rule: allowed pair is suspect when dHash distance <=4 or aHash distance <=4; suspect status does not exclude

static_code_inspection.observed_behavior: v4/v5 decodes and preprocesses once per filename/model group, but does not expose a persistent cache of post-vision-encoder features

baseline_sampling.method: random.Random(seed).sample over bytewise target and numeric donor adjacency order

text_diagnostic_protocol.high_content_word_overlap_rule: maximum exact content-word intersection divided by smaller caption content-word set is at least 0.5; sklearn English stop words removed
text_diagnostic_protocol.hull_mention_rule: case-insensitive exact full-lexeme set intersection; punctuation-only lexemes excluded; no stemming or semantic expansion
text_diagnostic_protocol.jaccard_tokenization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, deterministic word/hyphen/apostrophe regex
